label: Microsoft Teams
description: Channels, chats, and messaging on Microsoft Teams via the Microsoft Graph API.
notes: Simplifications: (1) All nodes hardcode the commercial Graph endpoint (graph.microsoft.com); the AP piece's GCC High cloud selector (graph.microsoft.us) is dropped. (2) sendChannelMessage omits the piece's @mention resolution (which paginates /teams/{id}/members and rewrites content into <at> tags — multi-request); plain content is sent as-is. (3) getChannelMessage drops the optional replyId prop because templates cannot branch the URL path; it fetches the parent message only. (4) createChannel/createPrivateChannel keep the optional description key since Graph accepts an empty-string description. (5) deleteChatMessage is transpilable via POST /me/chats/{chatId}/messages/{id}/softDelete but was left out under the 8-action cap in favor of create/send/get/search ops. (6) findTeamMember needs a conditionally-constructed OData filter (search by email vs name) which templates cannot express — classified needsPieceRuntime. Other needsPieceRuntime actions: createChatAndSendMessage (resolves /me, builds typed member array with @odata.bind, then two POSTs), getMeetingTranscript and getMeetingRecording (meeting-ID resolution helper plus conditional list-vs-fetch paths), requestApprovalInChannel and requestApprovalDirectMessage (workflow waitpoints and adaptive-card attachments). Triggers skipped: newChannelMessage, newChannel, newChat, newChatMessage.
